description: This file defines a React component 'TasksPage' for managing tasks, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting tasks, with associated project data fetching and UI rendering.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads tasks and projects data from API and updates state.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Prepares the form for editing an existing task and opens the modal.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Prepares the form for creating a new task and opens the modal.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the task (create or update) via API and reloads the task list.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a task via API after user confirmation and reloads the list.
